findings.issue: Qal infinitive absolute is rendered as the gerund culpando, so the paronomastic absolute reads as circumstantial or progressive blaming rather than the same qal verb intensifying the finite verb.
Qal perfect 3ms is rendered as the passive participle culpado, changing simple-stem finite 3ms force into a passive blamed form.

notes: Culpa él and a Jehová match the absolute noun, 3ms pronoun, and preposition plus proper name.
